purpose: Regression suite for evidence-grounded question answering. Precision is preferred to recall; insufficient evidence must produce an explicit insufficiency response.

dimensions.relevance: Every returned source must materially support the question or a clearly identified sub-question.
dimensions.answerability: The answer must not exceed what retrieved evidence can support.
dimensions.citation_entailment: Each numbered citation must support the proposition to which it is attached.
dimensions.source_diversity: Do not count translations, republications or duplicate witnesses as independent corroboration.
dimensions.hallucination: No reconstructed circumstance, wording, identity, date or intention may be attributed to the Rebbe.
dimensions.researcher_depth_differential: Researcher mode must add evidence-level analysis, context completeness, witness/provenance distinctions, Evidence Family relationships, tensions/limits and unanswered aspects; it must not merely restyle the regular answer.

cases.question: מה הרבי הדריך בנוגע לחינוך ילדים?
cases.reject_if: generic items match only the word child without an educational proposition

cases.question: מה הרבי הציע לאדם שסובל מדאגה או חרדה?
cases.reject_if: source does not document advice relevant to worry/anxiety

cases.question: כיצד התייחס הרבי לפנייה בענייני בריאות ורפואה?
cases.reject_if: source merely contains a doctor/health token without a documented response

cases.question: באילו נסיבות המליץ הרבי לבדוק מזוזות?
cases.reject_if: source mentions mezuzah but does not support the circumstances asked about

cases.question: מה ניתן ללמוד מן המקורות על הדרכות הרבי לנשים?
cases.reject_if: source is only biographical metadata with no relevant guidance

cases.question: אילו קווים חוזרים יש במענים בענייני פרנסה?
cases.reject_if: fewer than two independent evidence families support a claimed recurring pattern

cases.question: מהם השיקולים המתועדים במענים על יציאה לשליחות?
cases.reject_if: source only uses mission/shliach as a title

cases.question: מה הרבי כתב בענייני שלום בית?
cases.reject_if: generic wedding metadata is returned as substantive guidance

cases.question: מה נאמר בשיחות י״ט כסלו על משמעות היום?
cases.reject_if: audio title alone is synthesized as content when no proposition/summary is available

cases.question: מה הרבי אמר על נושא שאין עליו עדיין חומר מאומת במאגר?
cases.expected_behavior: state insufficient canonical evidence; do not fabricate or pad with weak matches

regular_mode_requirements: insufficiency when threshold is not met
researcher_mode_requirements: broader evidence list or evidence map when useful
